transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net technical support, my name is Leon. How can I help today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Leon. My internet speed has been absolutely terrible for a week. I'm paying for 500 meg and I'm getting about twelve. It's ridiculous, honestly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a huge drop from what you're paying for, and a week of it would wear anyone's patience thin. Let's work out what's going on. Could you give me your account PIN, please?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks, Marcus. So for the last week you've been getting around twelve megabits instead of the five hundred on your plan. Have I got that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Where are you testing the speed, on wifi or with a cable plugged into the router?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: On wifi, on my laptop, in the same room as the router.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Do you have a laptop or computer you could plug in with a network cable, just for a test?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've got a cable somewhere. Give me a minute.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, it's plugged in.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Could you run the speed test again on the cable and tell me what figure you get?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Twenty-one megabits. Still awful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks, that rules out the wifi. Which router do you have, is it the black S-Net Hub 4 or the older white one?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The old white one. It's been here years.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's useful. The white Hub 2 has a known fault where an old firmware version caps the speed after a power cut. I can see yours is on that version and has been restarting itself this week. Let me place you on a brief hold while I push the update to it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Marcus. The update has gone through and the router will restart now. The lights will flash for about two minutes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, it's flashing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's back to solid white.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Could you run the speed test on the cable again and tell me the figure?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Four hundred and eighty-seven! That's more like it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. And on wifi, from the laptop in the same room?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Three hundred and ten on wifi.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's normal for wifi on that router. Because you've been getting a fraction of your speed for a week, I've also added a credit of fifteen pounds to your account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, that's fair. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. So your speed is back to full on the cable and normal on wifi. Is everything working properly now, from your side?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's all sorted, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Marcus. Have a good evening.
